product_family: Spend management, expense reporting, corporate cards, travel, bill pay, payroll

certifications.name: SOC 1 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 1 Type 2 Report [listed as downloadable report in Trust Center Reports section; annual audit by qualified independent third-party auditors confirmed]

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: Undergoing annual SOC 1 Type 2 and SOC 2 Type 2 audits by qualified, independent third-party auditors

certifications.name: PCI DSS 4.0.1
certifications.proof_quote: PCI DSS 4.0.1 [listed under Compliance section of Trust Center; geographically redundant, PCI-compliant data center architecture confirmed]

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: GDPR [listed as COMPLIANT in Trust Center compliance section; EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework and Standard Contractual Clauses in place for EEA transfers]

certifications.name: CCPA
certifications.proof_quote: CCPA COMPLIANT [explicitly listed in Trust Center Compliance section with detailed California rights provisions in Privacy Policy]

certifications.name: Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA)
certifications.proof_quote: Digital Operational Resilience Act [listed in Trust Center compliance section; EU financial services clients may request supporting documentation]

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.source: Not mentioned in trust center, help documentation, SEC filings, or web searches reviewed. Cannot confirm this certification is held.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.source: Not mentioned in any public documentation. Product handles financial and expense data, not protected health information (PHI). HIPAA not applicable to core use case.

privacy.ai_training_note: Expensify uses 'Concierge AI' for automated expense categorization and policy enforcement on user data. OpenAI L.L.C. is listed as a subprocessor but only for content moderation of member-generated community/chat posts to enforce Acceptable Use Policy. Privacy policy states: 'third party service providers such as OpenAI, L.L.C., to ensure compliance with our Acceptable Use Policy and Content Standards.' No evidence that customer expense data, receipts, or financial records are used to train any AI model. Mobile analytics software explicitly does not link to PII.
privacy.data_region: United States (AWS primary infrastructure). EEA/UK data transfers covered by Standard Contractual Clauses and EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework. No customer-selectable multi-region data residency found. UK/EEA card-related data handled by Transact Payments Malta Limited and Transact Payments Limited (Gibraltar FSC regulated).

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: HTTPS + TLS enforced for all web connections

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Dual-control key system: encryption key split into two parts stored in separate secure locations, managed by different employees

security.name: Cloud infrastructure
security.value: Amazon Web Services (cloud infrastructure), Cloudflare (CDN and security), DocuSign (document management), GitHub (version control) - all listed as subprocessors

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Annual third-party penetration tests conducted by external experts

security.name: Bug bounty / vulnerability disclosure
security.value: No formal bug bounty platform (HackerOne or Bugcrowd not confirmed). Responsible disclosure via security@expensify.com with PGP public key published at use.expensify.com/keys

security.name: Vulnerability monitoring
security.value: Vulnerability and system monitoring procedures established; control self-assessments conducted

security.name: Employee security
security.value: Background checks for all employees and contractors, refreshed annually; NDAs required; ongoing security and privacy training mandatory

security.name: Endpoint management
security.value: MDM system utilized; remote access encryption enforced

security.name: Business continuity
security.value: Continuity and Disaster Recovery plans established; Change management and Whistleblower policies in place

security.name: Data governance
security.value: Data retention procedures and data classification policy established; DPAs signed with all subprocessor vendors

products.name: Expensify Individual / Free
products.data_scope: Personal expense data, receipt images, basic bank transaction data. Limited SmartScans per month on free tier.
products.notes: Free to use individually. No enterprise controls. Data handled under standard privacy policy.

products.name: Expensify Collect ($5/member/month)
products.data_scope: Company expense data, receipts, ACH reimbursements, Expensify Card transactions, QuickBooks/Xero integration data
products.notes: Flat per-member billing regardless of activity. Includes unlimited SmartScans, ACH reimbursement, Expensify Card, and accounting integrations. SOC 2 and PCI DSS coverage applies.

products.name: Expensify Control ($9/member/month)
products.data_scope: Enterprise financial data, expense reports, SAML/SSO identity data, NetSuite/Sage Intacct ERP integration, custom reporting
products.notes: Active-member billing model. Adds enterprise controls: SAML/SSO, multiple approval layers, advanced integrations. Full SOC 1/SOC 2/PCI DSS coverage. Enterprise agreements available via Statement of Work.

products.name: Expensify Card (Visa Commercial Card)
products.data_scope: PCI-regulated cardholder data, credit card transactions, spend controls
products.notes: Issued by The Bancorp Bank, N.A. (US). EEA/UK cards issued by Transact Payments Malta Limited (MFSA regulated) and Transact Payments Limited (Gibraltar FSC regulated). PCI DSS 4.0.1 directly applicable.

products.name: Expensify Travel
products.data_scope: Travel booking data, traveler PII (name, dates, preferences), payment data
products.notes: Powered by Spotnana Technology Inc. (listed as subprocessor in Privacy Policy). Separate Travel Terms apply. Traveler data shared with Spotnana for booking fulfillment.

products.name: Expensify Payroll
products.data_scope: SSN, EIN, bank routing/account numbers, tax withholding (dependents, filing status), employment data, government-issued IDs
products.notes: Highest sensitivity product. Subject to separate Payroll Terms. Collects SSN and financial identifiers. Requires additional DPA review for HR/payroll use cases. Separate subprocessors may apply.

products.name: Expensify Bill Pay and Invoicing
products.data_scope: Vendor/client bank details, payment amounts, ACH transaction data, check printing data
products.notes: Members authorize ACH debits/credits from linked financial accounts. Check printing via third-party provider. Accuracy of bank details is user's responsibility.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium + per-user SaaS. Free individual tier (limited SmartScans). Collect: $5/member/month (all workspace members billed). Control: $9/member/month (active members only). Enterprise via Statement of Work with custom terms. UK: GBP 5/month; Australia: AUD 8/month; NZ: NZD 9/month.
compare.data_residency: US-only (AWS). No customer-selectable data residency. EEA/UK data covered by Standard Contractual Clauses and EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework. Card data for EEA/UK residents handled by Malta/Gibraltar-regulated entities.

flags: Payroll product collects SSN, EIN, bank routing numbers, and tax data - significantly higher sensitivity than core expense management. Warrants separate DPA and vendor review for payroll use cases.

OpenAI L.L.C. is a listed subprocessor for content moderation of member-generated chat/forum posts (not expense financial data). Verify if your deployment involves community features before sending data.
Spotnana Technology Inc. handles travel booking data as a subprocessor under separate Travel Terms. Assess independently if travel module is in scope.
No formal bug bounty platform (HackerOne or Bugcrowd) confirmed. Only email disclosure channel (security@expensify.com with PGP). Gap for a PCI-scoped financial product.
DORA listed on trust center but formal compliance certification vs. self-attestation not confirmed. EU financial services customers should request specific documentation.
No ISO 27001 certification despite enterprise positioning and PCI/SOC 2 program maturity.
McAfee SECURE referenced in older help docs - this program was discontinued and should be treated as legacy content, not a current certification.
